title: Trump to Meet Xi and Putin in China. In 1972 Nixon Went First #shorts
description:
This week President Trump said he expects to meet China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit in China. In February 1972, Richard Nixon became the first American president to visit Communist China, after more than two decades without contact.
